sentiment.label: risk_off
sentiment.reason_it: Il VIX a 17,2 indica ancora un mercato difensivo, ma la contrazione del S&P 500 (-0,45%) e il calo del Brent (-0,58%) spingono verso un sentiment di risk‑off. Il DXY è leggermente debole a 99,60 (-0,04%), il che è bullish per le commodity, ma il rialzo del TLT (-0,27%) segnala tassi in aumento (bearish). La guerra in corso tra USA e Iran aggiunge pressione geopolitica (2 punti). In sintesi: VIX basso, equity in ribasso, tassi in salita e conflitto attivo → sentiment risk‑off con score 6.
sentiment.reason_en: The VIX at 17.2 still reflects a defensive market, yet the S&P 500 decline (-0.45%) and Brent drop (-0.58%) tilt the tone toward risk‑off. The DXY is marginally weak at 99.60 (-0.04%), which is bullish for commodities, but the TLT fall (-0.27%) signals rising rates (bearish). The ongoing US‑Iran war adds geopolitical pressure (2 points). In short: low VIX, equities down, rates up and active conflict → risk‑off sentiment with a score of 6.

Il DXY a 99,60 (-0,04%) resta debole, sostenendo le materie prime, ma la guerra USA‑Iran pesa sul sentiment globale.
market_impact_summary.en: Equities: S&P 500 -0.45% and STOXX 600 -0.44% signal bearish pressure. Fixed income: TLT -0.27% and US 10Y Yield +0.71% point to rising rates, confirming a bearish outlook for bonds. Commodities: Brent -0.58% versus Gold +0.80% reflect ongoing debasement dynamics.
